stations.title: Anjali
stations.say: Show what I have, cheapest first.

stations.title: shop.js
stations.text: Six items, one of them sold out.
stations.note: New items go at the end.

captions: At the gift shop, Anjali wants the till screen to show her stock, cheapest first.
The screen shows three items typed in last month, and the map sold out weeks ago.
You draw the list from her stock and put it in order, in four tasks.
The sold-out map is gone and every item in stock is listed by price.
Same stock list, a true screen. New items appear the moment she adds them.
